h1: Custom Heart Candles for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom heart candles in bulk for events or gifts. Personalize with your logo. Shop at Perfect Imprints today.
introHtml: Heart-shaped candles add a personal touch that standard cylinders or pillars can't match. Whether you're honoring employees during Valentine's Day or creating a memorable giveaway for a charity gala, the distinct silhouette signals care and thoughtfulness. These candles work well with screen-printed logos or custom labels, and popular scents like Santal or Bamboo Soy make them unisex enough for any audience. Bulk orders keep per-unit costs low while delivering a gift that recipients actually keep.
heroAltText: Bulk custom heart candles with logo imprint in assorted scents for corporate gifts
